忙完这些回到店里，天已经黑了。

赵素梅给他留了饭，在灶上温着。

他坐在柜台旁边吃，赵志军从后厨出来，把今天的账本放在桌上。

“三姐夫，今天的账。”

林国强翻开看了看，营业额稳定，包桌有三场，散客也不少。

“志军，现在厨房的活儿你盯得住不？”

赵志军挺了挺胸：“盯得住，面食、卤味、炒菜，都行。

就是你那几道招牌菜，鱼香肉丝、宫保鸡丁、红烧肉，火候我还得再练练。”

“多练就行，接下来我可能要忙菜地和大棚的事，店里你多上心。”

赵志军使劲点头。

老宅那边，林国栋的日子不好过。

林国伟的杂货铺开起来后，虽然生意不温不火，但一个月好歹能挣个五六十块，比在采石场强多了。

周桂芳在店里盯着，林国伟负责进货。

两个孩子放学了就在店里玩，一家子忙忙活活，倒也像个过日子的样子。

林国栋看在眼里，急在心里。

他跑运输，三天打鱼两天晒网，有时候一个月挣十几块，有时候一分没有。

徐青青天天跟他吵，说他没出息，说大哥都知道开店，他啥也不会。

“你看看大哥！看看二哥！哪个不比你强？

我当初怎么瞎了眼嫁了你这么个窝囊废！”

徐青青坐在炕沿上，一边抹眼泪一边骂。

林国栋蹲在门槛上，闷头抽烟，一句话不敢回。

“你去找二哥！他不是要搞什么菜地大棚吗？肯定要人帮忙。

你去帮忙，他还能不给你开工钱？”

林国栋动了心思。

但他抹不开脸。

上回李红霞去说合股被怼回来，他也在场。

林国强那句“他们懂配方吗”像根刺一样扎在他心里。

可现在，实在没别的路了。

第二天一早，他硬着头皮去了国强饭店。

林国强正在后门卸菜，张老四刚送来一车萝卜。

林国栋站在旁边，想帮忙又不好意思伸手，等林国强卸完了，他才凑上去。

“二哥。”

林国强拍了拍手上的土：“有事？”

“那啥……听说你要搞菜地，还要弄啥大棚？”

When I returned to the store after all this work, it was already dark.

Zhao Sumei left some rice for him and warmed it on the stove.

He sat at the counter and ate. Zhao Zhijun came out of the back kitchen and put today's account book on the table.

"Third brother-in-law, today's account."

Lin Guoqiang opened it and looked at it. The turnover was stable, there were three reserved tables, and there were many individual customers.

"Zhijun, can you keep an eye on the kitchen work now?"

Zhao Zhijun puffed up his chest and said: "Keep an eye on it, pasta, braised food, stir-fry, everything will do.

Those are your signature dishes, fish-flavored shredded pork, Kung Pao chicken, and braised pork. I still need to practice the heat."

"Just practice more. I may have to work on the vegetable fields and greenhouses next, so please pay more attention to the store."

Zhao Zhijun nodded vigorously.

Over at the old house, Lin Guodong's life was difficult.

After Lin Guowei's grocery store opened, although the business was tepid, he could still earn fifty or sixty yuan a month, which was much better than working in the quarry.

Zhou Guifang was watching in the store, while Lin Guowei was in charge of purchasing goods.

The two children were playing in the store after school. The whole family was busy working, and it seemed like they were living a normal life.

Lin Guodong saw it and was anxious in his heart.

He works as a transporter and spends three days fishing and two days drying nets. Sometimes he earns more than ten yuan a month, sometimes not a penny.

Xu Qingqing quarreled with him every day, saying that he was worthless and that even his elder brother knew how to open a store, but he didn't know how to do anything.

"Look at the eldest brother! Look at the second brother! Who is not better than you?

Why did I blindly marry a loser like you in the first place!"

Xu Qingqing sat on the edge of the Kang, wiping her tears and cursing.

Lin Guodong squatted on the threshold, smoking a cigarette, not daring to reply.

"Go find the second brother! Isn't he going to build a vegetable greenhouse? He definitely needs help.

If you go to help, can he still give you wages?"

Lin Guodong changed his mind.

But he couldn't wipe his face.

The last time Li Hongxia went to talk about a joint venture and was criticized back, he was also present.

Lin Guoqiang's words "Do they know the formula?" stuck in his heart like a thorn.

But now, there is really no other way.

Early the next morning, he bit the bullet and went to Guoqiang Hotel.

Lin Guoqiang was unloading vegetables at the back door, and Zhang Laosi had just delivered a cart of radishes.

Lin Guodong stood nearby. He wanted to help but was too embarrassed to reach out. He waited until Lin Guoqiang finished unloading before he stepped forward.

"Second brother."

Lin Guoqiang patted the dirt on his hands: "Is something wrong?"

"Then... I heard that you are going to build a vegetable garden. What kind of greenhouses are you going to build?"
